_key.description: Genomic element key and phenotype ontology term joined by an underscore, for example CRISPR_chr1_101174581_101175330_GRCh38_IGVFFI5135QZCS_GO_0016477.

z_score.description: Average phenotype z-score across guides targeting the genomic element

p_value.description: P-value for the element's association with the screened phenotype.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: -log10 of p_value, capped at 240 where the source file reports a p-value of exactly 0.

significant.description: Whether the genomic element met the significance threshold for the phenotype

num_guides.description: Number of guides targeting the element in the screen.

num_guides_hit.description: Number of guides that met hit thresholds

num_guides_nonhit.description: Number of guides that did not meet hit thresholds

fraction_guides_hit.description: Fraction of guides that met hit thresholds

crispr_modality.description: The CRISPR modality from the associated files_filesets record

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.
biological_context.example: human HFF-1 cell line from donor(s) IGVFDO0058YJWC

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: class, label, method, crispr_modality, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, z_score, p_value, neg_log10_pvalue, significant, num_guides, num_guides_hit, num_guides_nonhit, fraction_guides_hit
